hook_line: ICE ARRESTS TWO ON SEA-TAC JETWAY, DELAYING LOS ANGELES-BOUND FLIGHT

hook_stat.sub: Delay to Alaska Airlines Flight 1306 after ICE arrests on the jetway at Sea-Tac

stats.label: People arrested by ICE during boarding at Sea-Tac
Scheduled departure of Flight 1306 to Los Angeles — it left at 11 a.m.
Known incident within a month of ICE arresting multiple people at Sea-Tac, per FOX 13

diaspora_bullets: ICE has stepped up arrests at airports, particularly of people who overstayed visas
Travelers with a pending application or a past overstay should take legal advice before flying domestically
news_summary: ICE officers arrested two people on the jetway of Alaska Airlines Flight 1306 at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday morning as passengers boarded for Los Angeles.
payoff: Flight 1306 departed at 11 a.m., about three hours late, and many passengers were moved to other flights.
